description: This file implements a class 'LanceDBVectorStore' providing a local vector store using LanceDB, including methods for initialization, data upsertion, search, deletion, and metadata management.

classes.name: LanceDBVectorStore
classes.description: A class implementing a vector store backed by LanceDB, supporting initialization, search, upsert, delete, and metadata operations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with workspace path, vector size, database directory, and LanceDB manager.

methods.name: loadLanceDBModule
methods.description: Dynamically loads the LanceDB module, ensuring dependencies are available.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Establishes and returns a connection to the LanceDB database.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Opens and returns the vector table from the database.

methods.name: _createSampleData
methods.description: Creates sample data for initializing the vector table schema.

methods.name: _createMetadataData
methods.description: Creates metadata entries for vector size and indexing status.

methods.name: _createVectorTable
methods.description: Creates the vector table and deletes sample data.

methods.name: _createMetadataTable
methods.description: Creates the metadata table.

methods.name: _dropTableIfExists
methods.description: Drops a specified table if it exists.

methods.name: _getStoredVectorSize
methods.description: Retrieves stored vector size from metadata.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the database and tables, recreating if necessary based on vector size.

methods.name: upsertPoints
methods.description: Inserts or updates points in the vector table.

methods.name: escapeSqlString
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in SQL strings.

methods.name: escapeSqlLikePattern
methods.description: Escapes special characters in LIKE patterns.

methods.name: isPayloadValid
methods.description: Validates the payload structure.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a vector similarity search with optional filtering.

methods.name: deletePointsByFilePath
methods.description: Deletes points associated with a specific file path.

methods.name: deletePointsByMultipleFilePaths
methods.description: Deletes points associated with multiple file paths.

methods.name: deleteCollection
methods.description: Deletes the entire collection and database files.

methods.name: clearCollection
methods.description: Clears all data from the collection.

methods.name: collectionExists
methods.description: Checks if the collection exists.

methods.name: closeConnect
methods.description: Closes database connection and resets table reference.

methods.name: optimizeTable
methods.description: Performs table optimization to reduce disk space and improve performance.

methods.name: hasIndexedData
methods.description: Checks if the collection has indexed data.

methods.name: markIndexingComplete
methods.description: Marks indexing as complete in metadata.

methods.name: markIndexingIncomplete
methods.description: Marks indexing as incomplete in metadata.
